description: Change the workspace's content autopilot. mode: off, draft_only (only suggests briefs, spends nothing) or requires_approval (approves up to the weekly quota of suggested briefs, which spends credits, and holds every draft for review). weekly_quota is capped by the plan. paused pauses or resumes. Auto-publishing (full_auto) cannot be switched on here; do that in the Rankwise app.

mode.description: full_auto is refused: switch on auto-publishing in the app.
